items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: when you went with the band, was Artie in it then?

ctx.x: That's right. Well, Cootie, let's see. That takes us to, I think about -- well, that was in '33. So in '34, let's start to think when Duke started to put some more people in the band. Now, I don't know how well we're going to
do about dates here, but when he started to augment the band, because -- for instance, when you went with the band, was Artie in it then?
